evidence.quote: Consumers were not affected during the frequency stability tests or when synchronous operation with the continental European grid started. The voltage regulation tests were successfully carried out on the high voltage 330kV network, and the voltage changes were within the planned range without affecting the quality of the power supply and the electrical installations of the consumers.

claims.explanation: The source directly states that consumers were not affected during the frequency stability tests conducted as part of the synchronisation of the Baltic electricity systems with the Continental Europe Synchronous Area. It also mentions that voltage regulation tests were carried out successfully without affecting power supply quality or electrical installations of consumers, supporting the claim that consumers experienced no impact during these tests.
